excerpt: Bachelor of Arts in Digital Journalism 48 monthsProgramme duration Programme overview Degree BA Study Level Undergraduate Study Mode On Campus The Department of Journalism and Media was established in the College of Humanities and Social Sciences at Princess Noura bint Abdul Rahman University in the academic year 1445 AH. It aims to achieve women’s leadership in the national development process. The department grants a bachelor's degree in digital journalism by offering an integrated academic program that keeps pace with successive developments in journalism and media, and aims to prepare media cadres with the necessary knowledge, and research and professional competence qualified in the field of journalism and media to contribute to community service. Career opportunities Graduates have the opportunity to work in various fields, including: Public Sector: Journalistic researcher, assistant journalistic researcher, journalistic editor, journalistic specialist, publications monitor, news editing secretary. Private Sector: Electronic content writer, electronic content manager, news correspondent, news editor, journalistic director. Nature and Goals of the Program The program aims to provide specialized journalists in the field of digital journalism.
